defects.canonical: get() reads the value without calling self._store.move_to_end(key), so a successful read does not refresh recency. A key that is read frequently but not re-put stays at the front of the OrderedDict and is wrongly evicted by popitem(last=False) on overflow, violating LRU semantics.
defects.why_subtle: put() correctly maintains recency, so the cache looks fully ordered; the missing move_to_end is an absence in get(), and a skimmer sees a plausible read path with no obvious error.
